title: A retryable commit failure (5xx, network, session expiry, 429) drops the commit instead of re-queuing it
failureClass: transient commit failure treated as terminal (silent loss of buffered edits)
source: INC-448 (App SDK reverted rejected saves with no retry); gap 12a/12b in 01-context.md
userVisibleEffect: After one failed commit the edit stays on screen but is never re-sent; the server never receives it
